title: Systems and methods for aircraft datalink performance monitoring
cluster: A - Aircraft datalink performance monitoring & ground-side analytics
what_it_discloses: Ground-side real/near-real-time monitoring of CPDLC and ADS-C message exchanges; end-to-end performance defined by beginning/ending events; per-transmission-step tx/rx timestamps; comparison to mandated performance benchmarks (PBCS RCP 240 / RSP 180); identification of the transmission step that is the greatest cause of delay; NOC alerting; datalink reconfiguration (VHF <-> satellite); dashboard with ACTP/PORT breakdown; monitoring of pilot operational response time (PORT).
differentiation_hook_for_our_filing: No host-OS/platform telemetry attribution, no certification-evidence output, no AI advisory architecture, no learned threat models.
verification: Full text retrieved from Google Patents
